name: After recital 2
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2021/947 as regards increased efficiency of the External Action Guarantee
part_text: (2 a) The External Action Guarantee should be used for strategic projects in the enlargement region, especially for regional connectivity in the Western Balkans, including the trans-European transport network (TEN-T).
